Loss report: gha -> drone
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Drone pipeline name is its id; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/prod job.outputs (Drone steps cannot pass values to other pipelines)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/prod job.runner (only the platform has a Drone form; other runner labels are lost)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/test job.runner (only the platform has a Drone form; other runner labels are lost)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/script step.script (the job has no steps; a no-op step keeps the document valid)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test-step-1 script.interpolation (no Drone spelling for expression needs.prod.outputs.ver; the line is commented out)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test-step-1 step.script (no command of the step has a Drone spelling; the step is not written)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/prod job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test job.matrix: one pipeline document per cell (fail-fast and max-parallel are lost; a failed sibling stops the others without order)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test step.script: no-op step (Drone needs a step; no step of the job has a Drone form, so a no-op step stands in)
